(i)
parts.text: State the value of $\text{E}(X)$ and find $\text{Var}(X)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A random variable, $W$, has probability density function given by

$$\text{g}(w) = \begin{cases} aw & 0 \leqslant w \leqslant b, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $a$ and $b$ are constants. Given that the median of $W$ is 2, find $a$ and $b$.
